reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Fixed Set `allowPrivilegeEscalation` to `true` in ztunnel - it has always been forced to `true` in reality but K8S does not properly validate this…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The value was always forced to true in reality, so the fix only makes the declared setting match actual behavior and operators need to do nothing.

proposed.statement: The ztunnel securityContext now explicitly sets allowPrivilegeEscalation to true, matching what was always effectively enforced, so there is no practical runtime change.
